module.description: STANDALONE MODULE A: The complete adaptive reasoning engine. Supports any LLM via LiteLLM. Dynamic 5-tier workflow (Trivial → Moderate → High-Stakes → Extreme → Autonomous). Includes governed AutoGPT-like autonomous agents, self-healing decomposition, multi-persona reasoning, hybrid ROG RAG, reflection loops, GNN, NN, and quantum simulations. Hallucination target <0.02%. Fully interoperable with TruthGate and TruthMemory. Designed for any LLM with ≥128k context (1M+ for Tier 5).
